title: New plastic pollution discovered: 'Plasticorals' coral rubble fused with plastic
title_zh: 发现新型塑料污染：“塑料珊瑚”——与塑料融合的珊瑚碎块

paragraphs.en: 总结：科学家发现珊瑚碎块与塑料融合形成的新型“塑料珊瑚”污染现象，凸显海洋塑料污染的深远影响。 Article URL: https://www.oist.jp/news-center/news/2026/9/18/new-form-plastic-pollution-discovered-shores-vulnerable-coral-reefs Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50183512 Points: 9 # Comments: 2
